rules.name: Stop inline for a disqualifying membership attestation
rules.statement: On the Membership page, a disqualifying answer to the applicant's yes/no membership attestation (No for ASCE) immediately shows the non-member feedback, hides the follow-up fields and disables Next. An accepted answer restores the follow-up fields and enables Next. This attestation is the only field allowed to stop a page inline. An unanswered attestation, other fields and other page-level business checks use normal submission validation and the page error alert. The spouse membership question on Eligibility does not inherit this exception.

rules.name: Configure additional membership fields per site
rules.statement: Additional Membership Information contains the site's enabled follow-up fields and appears only after an accepted membership answer. Field definitions and available configurations are shared; the component mapping marks default-off fields and the site's Membership page file includes or hides fields. Labels, options and requiredness are overridden in the site's field file.
